inbox.subject: Weekly Engineering Standup Notes – 2026-09-29
inbox.body:
Team,

Here are the highlights from today's standup:
- Service deployment to staging is complete.
- The latency spike from last week has been resolved (root cause: misconfigured cache TTL).
- Next week we'll focus on the API rate-limiting feature.

Slack thread for follow-up questions.

Bob

inbox.subject: Reminder: Annual Performance Review Submissions Due Oct 10
inbox.body:
Dear colleagues,

This is a reminder that self-assessment forms for the annual performance review must be submitted by October 10. Please log into the HR portal and complete the form.

If you have any questions, reach out to the HR team.

Regards,
Carol

inbox.subject: Scheduled Maintenance Window – Oct 4, 02:00–04:00 UTC
inbox.body:
Hello,

No action required from your side.

DevOps

inbox.subject: Roadmap Update: Feature Freeze for v2.4
inbox.body:
Team,

Feature freeze for the v2.4 release is set for October 15. Any new feature requests after that date will be queued for v2.5.

Please update your Jira tickets accordingly and flag any blockers to me directly.

Dan
